description: This file contains unit tests for the AlwaysInterleaveDiagnosticAnalyzer, verifying correct and incorrect usage of the [AlwaysInterleave] attribute in Orleans grain interfaces and implementations.

classes.name: AlwaysInterleaveDiagnosticAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the AlwaysInterleaveDiagnosticAnalyzer, testing attribute usage scenarios.

methods.name: GetDiagnosticsAsync
methods.description: Overrides base method to get diagnostics with additional usings.

methods.name: AlwaysInterleave_Analyzer_NoWarningsIfAttributeIsNotUsed
methods.description: Test that no diagnostics are reported when the attribute is not used.

methods.name: AlwaysInterleave_Analyzer_NoWarningsIfAttributeIsUsedOnInterface
methods.description: Test that no diagnostics are reported when the attribute is correctly used on an interface method.

methods.name: AlwaysInterleave_Analyzer_WarningIfAttributeisUsedOnGrainClass
methods.description: Test that a diagnostic warning is reported when the attribute is incorrectly used on a class method.
